goal: Allow REST clients to retrieve block headers from stale branches
Enables tracing chain reorganizations without having to fall back to the getblockheader RPC
agreement: Broad concept support for exposing stale headers via REST
Tested and prefers query parameters over maintaining a new endpoint (jeanpablojp)
Unaddressed suggestion to use a dedicated endpoint instead of query parameters (0xB10C)
Concept approval without stated reasons (sedited, w0xlt)

categories.name: rpc
why: P3 because it closes an interface gap by bringing REST to parity with the getblockheader RPC
Directly benefits tools like fork-observer when following reorgs without requiring RPC access
